changelog: v2.2.2: Theme 2 is now 100% responsive across all devices. Added mobile app-like bottom navigation bar (Home/Search/Magazine/Poll/Menu) fixed at bottom on screens ≤1024px with safe-area-inset support for notched phones. Bento Hero Grid stacks vertically on tablet/mobile. Split category sections, main content+sidebar grid, and latest news horizontal cards all collapse correctly. Fixed missing @keyframes ticker animation in Theme 2 (was suppressed with global ticker). Added fluid clamp() padding on content container. Added hover micro-animations for bento cards, split items, and Top 10 cards.
